author_or_account: WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control
title: Youth-oriented marketing of nicotine products
discussion_signal: The post describes flavours, colourful packaging, and youth-oriented marketing as mechanisms that can make nicotine products more attractive and weaken health warnings. It frames consumer choice as shaped by commercial design and regulatory gaps, especially for adolescents.
linked_research_question: How do product design, marketing, and regulatory gaps shape youth exposure, choice, and the possibility of informed consumer protection?
limits: No platform or campaign-level exposure estimate is presented
The post does not assess enforcement outcomes
